refs/hatcher-algebraic-topology/AT.txt:17798-17800 VERBATIM: "Theorem 3C.4. If A is a commutative, associative Hopf algebra over a field F of
characteristic 0 , and An is finite-dimensional over F for each n , then A is isomorphic as an algebra to the tensor product of an exterior algebra on odd-dimensional
generators and a polynomial algebra on even-dimensional generators."
